What this supports

The source publications describe twelve research topics across measurement, therapy, home practice, equity and participation. The study index identifies the populations and available original report links.

Scope & limits

Small study cohorts cannot be replaced by cumulative network-service totals. Journal peer review, independent replication and ethics approval require their own documents. Findings apply to the populations and methods studied.

School-entry findings must remain qualified to children meeting readiness criteria; the parent-led generalisation report notes limitations and a non-significant home-adherence correlation.
